_doc._status: ALL NUMBERS BELOW ARE UNCALIBRATED PLACEHOLDERS / ASSUMPTIONS, not measurements. Replace latency and limit values with figures measured from real probes before reporting results as 'calibrated'.
_doc.seed: Seed for random.Random. All per-request random draws (failure die, TTFT, chunk gaps) are made at admission time, so a run is reproducible given the same arrival order.
_doc.model_name: Echoed in responses when the request has no model.
_doc.limits: mode: 'token_bucket' (default) or 'sliding_window'. token_bucket: rpm and tpm are CONTINUOUSLY REFILLING buckets (capacity = rpm or tpm, refill = capacity/60 per second, start full), matching measured Groq free-tier behaviour. A request needs request-bucket >= 1 and token-bucket >= requested, where requested = prompt_tokens(chars/4) + max_tokens; both are deducted at admission, and when the response completes the token bucket is refunded max_tokens - actual completion tokens (capped at capacity), so the effective cost is the actual usage. On failure: 429 'Limit L, Used X, Requested Y. Please try again in Zs' with Z = deficit / refill rate and retry-after = ceil(Z). x-ratelimit-remaining-tokens = floor(token level); x-ratelimit-reset-tokens = time until the token bucket is full (Go-style, e.g. '1.507s', '1m26.4s'). sliding_window: the old model, rpm/tpm are sliding 60 s windows with the reservation kept for 60 s (no refund). In both modes rpd/tpd are simple counters (reset only via POST /admin/reset); x-ratelimit-*-requests headers report the day counters. TPD check uses requested against actual tokens used so far; TPD usage is incremented by actual prompt+completion tokens when a response finishes.
_doc.day_reset_s: Seconds after server start (or last reset) until day counters 'reset'; only used for retry-after / x-ratelimit-reset-requests on day-limit 429s.
_doc.ttft_ms: Lognormal for time-to-first-content-token: {median, p95} in ms; mu=ln(median), sigma=ln(p95/median)/1.645. Added to prompt processing time.
_doc.inter_chunk_ms: Lognormal for the gap between streamed content chunks: {median, p95} ms.
_doc.tokens_per_chunk: Approx tokens per streamed content chunk (1 token = 4 chars).
_doc.prompt_ms_per_1k_tokens: Extra time-to-first-token per 1000 prompt tokens (reported as usage.prompt_time).
_doc.overload: knee_in_flight: number of concurrent requests the service handles at full speed. slowdown_per_extra: multiplier base; factor = slowdown_per_extra ** max(0, in_flight - knee_in_flight), applied to TTFT and chunk gaps, recomputed at each sleep from the CURRENT in-flight count.
_doc.max_in_flight: Hard cap. Requests arriving when in_flight >= max_in_flight get HTTP 503 immediately (no queueing; limits are not consumed). 0 = unlimited.
_doc.failures: SYNTHETIC fault injection, not observed Groq behaviour. p_5xx: HTTP 500 after admission. p_hang: sleep (up to 1 h) so the client times out. p_slow_success: success whose latencies are multiplied by slow_multiplier (long tail).
_doc.replay_bank: JSONL path; lines {question_id, setting, text, tokens_out}. Matched on X-Relay-Question-Id + first letter of X-Relay-Setting (case-insensitive). Missing file = no bank.
_doc.fallback: No bank hit: short answer citing the first '[paper p.N]' tag in the prompt, else 'NOT_IN_PAPERS: ...'.
